name: Cats
summary: A cloned project gets its own engine version back, and engine changes no longer fail on the engine's own developer checks.
changes: New projects record their engine in Project.json ("engine": {"version"}). Engine/ stays out of git, so the launcher installs this version for whoever clones the project. See Docs/ProjectSetup.md.

A game's tests no longer include Engine.Tools and Engine.ThirdPartyNotices. They check the engine repository itself (git, agent tools), so changing a project's engine in the launcher failed on machines without them.
